title: Message/queryChanges: index positions wrong for chats with >200 messages
description: Trigger: chat has >200 messages. MessageQueryChangesHandler calls list_by_chat(&chat_id, 200) to fetch the positional reference list (hard cap), then for each added_id in the changeset calls full_list.iter().position(...). Any message at position >=200 in the real order is absent from full_list, so position() returns None and that message is either omitted from 'added' or assigned a wrong index. The client receives a queryChanges response with incorrect 'index' values, causing the client to re-fetch from the wrong offset. Fix: either remove the 200-cap for queryChanges (use unbounded list_by_chat), or use a SQL-level row-number query instead of in-memory position scanning.
